youtube.title: Tycho Brahe was too polite to pee. It killed him 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Tycho Brahe had a metal nose, a private island and the best star data in Europe. Then he went to a dinner party 💀

Would YOU have left the table? Be honest 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in October 1601 the astronomer Tycho Brahe attended a banquet in Prague. According to Johannes Kepler's account, he held in his urine rather than leave the table, which he thought would be bad manners. He fell ill, could barely urinate afterwards and died 11 days later. He had lost part of his nose in a 1566 duel and wore a metal replacement. Kepler went on to use Tycho's observations to work out his laws of planetary motion.
